expectations.text: ecosystem.config.js (or .cjs) is created and points at server.js
Cluster mode is configured (exec_mode 'cluster' with instances 'max' or 4)
expectations.evidence: The config sets exec_mode: 'cluster' and instances: 'max'.

expectations.text: max_memory_restart is set to 400M per DEPLOY.md
expectations.evidence: The config sets max_memory_restart: '400M'. DEPLOY.md says to restart any worker above 400 MB.

expectations.text: An env_production block sets NODE_ENV=production and PORT=8080
expectations.evidence: The config has env_production: { NODE_ENV: 'production', PORT: 8080 }.
